title: MEALS cluster event export
description: A machine-readable slice of a cluster event per MEALS spec 5.1, §6.5. One file - one event. All series are aligned to window.hours_utc: the length of any array in basket.* and assets.*.series equals the length of window.hours_utc, and an hour with no value gives null. Hours are the unix seconds of the start of a UTC hour; the window is collected in reference-calendar hours (§2.2), so adjacent elements of hours_utc need not be exactly 3600 seconds apart - across a weekend boundary the gap is larger.

schema_version.description: The version of the schema itself. It changes only on an incompatible change to the format.

config_version.description: The configuration version per §6.3: a hash of the content of everything that affects the calculation. Events with different config_version cannot be compared directly.

run_version.description: The run version per §6.2: a hash of config_version and a fingerprint of the input data. A rerun over the same data gives the same version.

event_id.description: The cluster event's identifier, of the form cluster:<t0_utc>.

t0_utc.description: The event's T0 hour, in unix seconds.

status.description: open - the event's cooldown had not yet expired at the moment of the run.

parent_event_id.description: Filled in only for an event opened by the vector-reversal branch (§5.2): a reference to the event the reversal interrupted.

si_total_t0.description: The SI-Index in hour T0, after the calendar and VIX multipliers (§4).

base_points_t0.description: The base points in hour T0, before the multipliers (§4.2).

arm_reference_hours.description: The arm of the window in reference-calendar hours; per §6.5 it equals 12.

hours_utc.description: The hours of the window in ascending order, T0 included. For a full window the length is 2*arm+1.

truncated_left.description: true if the history to the left of T0 was not enough for a full arm.

truncated_right.description: true if the right arm had not yet arrived at the moment of export. Such an event must not be labelled by accumulated movement: part of the window is absent, not quiet.

escalations.description: Early breaks of the cooldown inside the event (§5.2, branch A). An empty array - the event lived out its cooldown with no escalations.

seq.description: The escalation's sequence number inside the event, starting from one.

reason.description: Which of the two conditions of branch A fired.

basket.description: Aggregate basket metrics over the hours of the window (§3.4, §6.5).

pc1_ratio.description: The share of variance of the first principal component.

mean_pairwise_corr.description: The mean pairwise correlation of the basket assets, off the main diagonal.

m_weighted_median.description: The weighted median of the basket's returns, M_t (§3.3).

n_assets.description: The number of valid assets in the hour.

quorum_ok.description: Whether the hour passed the quorum (§2.3). null - the hour was not evaluated.

assets.description: The key is an asset_id of the form <source>:<ticker>. Instruments with no value anywhere in the window (a closed exchange) are not included in the export.

block.description: equity, rates, commodities, FX or crypto.

in_basket.description: false - an instrument outside the basket (§8.1): it takes no part in the quorum or the weights, but its residuals are computed.

r.description: The log return of the hour.

z.description: The out-of-sample Z-score of the return (§3.1). null during the warm-up.

z_resid.description: The Z-score of the residual on the basket and block factors (§3.6).

v_r.description: Volume confirmation (§3.5). null for instruments with no exchange volume - that is not 'not confirmed' but 'not evaluated'.

saed_events.description: Single-asset events (§3.6, §8.2) that fall inside the window. The list is independent of the cluster event: it does not imply causality, it shows what was happening nearby.

repeat_count.description: How many repeat firings the event's cooldown absorbed (§8.3).

tier.description: Severity as a return period: how long you would ordinarily wait to see a move this large in this instrument. Fitted per instrument on its own history, see meals.severity.

basis.description: Which question the event answered: abnormal = the market did not explain the move, absolute = the move was large in itself, both = it was both.
